messages:
Avery (CS): Heads up — Enterprise customer Stonewell says the sales-issued credit from their PO didn’t show up on the April invoice. Sales sent a manual credit (contract promo) for $12,500 tied to PO S-PO-92. They’re asking for it to be applied retroactively to INV-2026-0789.
Priya (Sales): Confirming — we issued the credit as part of the contract addendum (sales order SO-998). PO note we put on the order is `SPO92` (no hyphen). Looks like billing has `S-PO-92`.
Avery (CS): Exact problem — customer pasted the PO into their accounting system with hyphen, so reconciliation failed. They hit our support flow because invoice still shows full amount due. Need manual adjustment + audit note.
Diego (Finance): I can do a one-off manual credit but need: invoice id, customer acct id, confirmation of amount, GL tag to use, and the exact PO note to attach for audit. Also who approved (sales approver) so we can keep the approvals trail.
Avery (CS): Invoice: INV-2026-0789, Account: acct-9092, Amount: $12,500. Sales approver: Priya. Suggested GL tag: `enterprise-sales-credit`.
Priya (Sales): Approved. Sales order SO-998 attached to contract SPO92. Please include note: "Contract SPO92 — manual credit per Sales order SO-998 (approved Priya)".
billing-bot: Automated check: no active promo code linked to acct-9092. Ledger shows no credit posted for INV-2026-0789.
Ryan (Eng): Quick verification query I can run to see if the credit transaction exists in our ledgers: ```SELECT tx_id, account_id, invoice_id, amount, note FROM ledger.transactions WHERE account_id='acct-9092' AND invoice_id='INV-2026-0789' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;```
Diego (Finance): Running that now...
Diego (Finance): Result: no rows returned. So nothing posted. Looks like PO-note mismatch prevented automated posting.
Avery (CS): Can we do manual post and ensure invoice balance goes to $0? Customer will re-open if balance remains. 
Diego (Finance): Yes. I'll post a manual credit. Need the canonical PO note string to put on the ledger so audits reconcile. Priya please confirm final phrasing.
Priya (Sales): Use exactly: `PO NOTE: Contract SPO92 — Grant manual credit per Sales order SO-998 (approved Priya).`
Diego (Finance): Got it. I'll create ledger transaction and reference journal entry JE-98765. Posting now; ETA ~10 minutes.
Avery (CS): Also please add internal tag `sales-manual-override` and reason: "PO note mismatch; customer reconciliation".
Diego (Finance): Adding tags. Also setting memo: "Manual credit applied per Sales request; original promo did not apply due to PO format mismatch."
billing-bot: Audit pre-check: required fields present: account_id, invoice_id, amount, approver. Approver recorded: Priya (Sales).
Diego (Finance): Done. Manual credit posted. Transaction id: TX-98765. Journal JE-98765. Invoice INV-2026-0789 new balance: $0.00.
Avery (CS): Fantastic — please also attach the PO and Sales approval to the journal for the customer audit.
Diego (Finance): Attached sales PDF and PO note to JE-98765.
Priya (Sales): Thanks team. Can we add a tiny automation ticket to detect hyphen vs non-hyphen PO forms for future? This is a recurring reconciliation footgun.
Ryan (Eng): I can add a lightweight check in the billing ingestion pipeline to normalize PO formatting (strip common punctuation) and flag mismatches. Will open ticket ENG-2231.
Avery (CS): Please ping when ENG-2231 is live so CS can let Stonewell know we fixed the root cause.
billing-bot: JE-98765 posted by Diego (Finance) at 1835004627. Thread closed by Avery (CS).
